intro: Sleek and stylish, Hannah’s refined design and contemporary headboard are crafted to appeal to the tastes of modern customers, blending seamlessly into any bedroom décor. Plush comfort or firm support - the Restomagic Dual let's you choose. The dual-sided mattress allows for with two firmness levels, so whatever your needs, you wake up rested and ready for the day.

features.title: Comfort on both sides, your way
features.text: Crave flexibility? Our dual-sided mattress lets you pick between plush comfort and firm support—so your bed adjusts to you.

features.title: Ledged headboard for display and utility
features.text: Elevate your space with the headboard’s ledge, perfect for displaying décor or keeping daily essentials like your phone and wallet within easy reach, offering both style and convenience.

features.title: Soft quilting adds an extra layer of comfort
features.text: Your bed should welcome you the moment you lie down, and our plush quilted top does exactly that, offering soft, breathable comfort that helps you unwind with ease.

features.title: Innovative box storage with sliding panels
features.text: Forget heavy lifting. The sliding panels provide easy access to under-bed storage, making organisation effortless and efficient while keeping clutter out of sight.

features.title: Stay reassured with our 5 year warranty
features.text: Rest easy with the assurance of a 5-year warranty. Crafted for durability and reliability, this mattress is backed by our commitment to quality, ensuring years of unmatched comfort and peace of mind.

features.title: Headboard with additional storage
features.text: Smart and spacious, the headboard doubles as a functional storage unit, ensuring all your belongings have a dedicated space without compromising on elegance.

name: Hannah And Restomagic Dual Queen Size Box Storage Bed Mattress Combo
